nom: Peach Slices Redness Relief Soothing Cleanser

avis.texte: I've been using Clinique for redness for years with no real results. Found this product and will continue buying. It definitely helps my rosacea. I've seen a noticeable difference now that I use this, the serum and the color-correcting moisturizer.
It is very effective at reducing redness, cleansing, and soothing the skin; I wish I had found this sooner!
My daughter has rosacea and has had me reorder this for the past few years. It helps her skin to feel and look more calm. She uses this whole line.
I like the cleanser, as it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped.

avis.titre: My go to cleanser right n
avis.texte: My go to cleanser right now. I have rosacea/sensitive skin and this is nice.
unfortunately this made my redness worse! still hunting for the prefect cleanser.

I LOVE this face wash!! I've used it routinely for over a year. It works great on my combination skin type. It can be drying if used excessively. I pair this with the peach slices acne moisturizer and have been doing so for over a year. I wouldn't say it helps so much with redness relief in my case, but it does help my face feel clean and it has helped me so far with small localized acne breakouts. Have and will be buying again!

This cleanser was recommended to me by my esthetician a couple of years ago, and I've been hooked ever since. I have redness on my cheeks, and this really helps to tone it down. It's such a light cleanser, but my face actually feels clean after using it.

I really love this cleanser, it has helped with my sensitive skin, with the redness from my rosacia. I use it along with Glass skin serum, and recently added the the glass skin mist and has helped my skin.

avis.titre: Bacteria starting growing in the lid of this product.
avis.texte: I keep this product in my shower, just like all other face washes I've used, my soaps, my shampoos, etc. This bottle developed a disgusting red clumpy mess (not the color of the product) in the lid when nothing else in my house has that. I thought it was mold, but an online search says it was bacteria of some kind. I will never use this again.

avis.titre: I love this face wash, works great for rosacea
avis.texte: I love this face wash, it's the only thing I have found that works for my rosacea and it doesn't cost a high price.. Will buy again & again!!!!

avis.titre: I will buy this again does got rid of the redness
avis.texte: I have been using this for a week now and does get rid of redness. It's gentle and creamy

I love this cleanser so much, I'll probably never use anything else. I have Post-Inflammatory Erythema along with very dry skin and I started using this cleanser and the matching calming cream and it has calmed my redness down so much! It has a more watery consistency which I was a little hesitant about at first but with skincare you really don't need to use that much. Just enough to create a good lather. At night I use a cleansing balm to take off my makeup before using this cleanser so that it really targets my skin and I love it! I see a lot of people saying they don't like the consistency or that it didn't work but I've found this is one of those products that does take a couple of weeks to produce results and consistent use helps redness a lot!

avis.titre: Effective 1st step in a double cleansing routine
avis.texte: Has helped even my skin tone and a nice first step in my cleansing routine. The smell is a little interesting at first but it's not bad once you get used to it
It's so bad. I don't feel like it cleanses at all. It smells awful and it burns my face!
I found this cleanser to be watery which made it messy to use. I have rosacea but i didn't notice any benefits of this cleanser.

avis.titre: Only series of items that has helped my redness
avis.texte: Really good, my rosacea has noticably dulled over the past few months of use
Gets my face clean and feels good. Doesn't really do anything for the redness in my cheeks. Disappointed in the redness reductiion

avis.titre: Not for Oily or Acne Prone Skin Types
avis.texte: It took me a while to accept that this cleanser with gentle ingredients was breaking me out. I love the Peach and Lily Glass skincare line and it never breaks me out, but this product seems aimed at drier skin types. This was ineffective at reducing my redness and i wouldnt recommend it for oily or acne prone skin types. It's gentle but i suspect the coconut-derived ingredients were clogging my pores bc i was getting zits in places unusual for me such as under my eyes and under my eyebrows. After i stopped using this, my skin immediately stopped breaking out in zits. Disappointed tbh:/
I am obsessed. I love how well this cleans my face without being heavy.

I have sensitive acne-prone skin that is getting drier as I'm nearing my thirties- I've tried lots of cleansers and this is good! I use this as my second cleanse after I use an oil-to-milk first cleanse to get sunscreen off. I switched over to this as my second cleanser after Ulta stopped carrying my holy grail AHA cleanser from another brand and it's been surprisingly good. It's not as hydrating as my holy grail and it can be a little stripping, but it doesn't break me out or cause irritation so that is a win in my book. The only thing to get used to is a lot comes out of the bottle because it is pretty watery, so you have to watch out for that. Please don't stop carrying this, Ulta!

The redness and irritation has been GREATLY reduced by using this cleanser. Even when using the other items from this line (serum, moisturizer) if I dont use THIS cleanser my skin is a wreck! It does have a distinctly herbal smell, but its not unpleasant or overpowering, and I appreciate no added fragrance to "cover it up" as that would likely be further irritating. This cleanser is hands down my favorite product for smooth, irritation-free skin with reduced redness and itchiness.

I purchased this hoping it would work well for my Rosacea and sensitive skin but it didn't seem to make any difference at all in soothing my irritable skin or reducing my redness, and it has a rather unfortunate smell of bacon grease.
Works well and calms redness Really like it because it is not too heavy for my combination skin. Will buy again

I have extremely sensitive skin and struggle with eczema flair ups around my face and eyes. I bought this during my worst flair up. This, with the matching moisturizer, single handedly soothed and balanced my skin back to normal. Its so gentle, but leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling dry or stripped. Some cleansers in the past have felt painful to use on my eczema, but this never has. I have tried to switch up my skincare in the past due to boredom; but, everytime I will get a flair up and the first time I go back to this line, it resets my skin. I can't recommend this product more.
I'm not too into the smell, but it helps my redness and face feels so fresh after washing with this.

This cleanser isn't bad, but I wouldn't buy it again which is why I'm only rating it 3 starts. I am really not a fan of the chemical smell it has, and I feel like I need to use a lot of product. That being said it is gentle and does a good job cleansing, I just feel like other cleansers at the price point have a more pleasing experience so I wouldn't rebuy.
Nice cleanser, very soapy and gentle on skin. Leaves a nice smooth finish on the skin after rinsing. Only downside is the smell, its not strong but is not pleasant. Kind of like damp smell
Really pleasant wash. Calms and leaves feeling clean without being dried out. My rosacea fluctuates but this seems to help calm it at down even when it's bad.

I have been using this face wash (& the matching serum) for a little over a month now and I don't think I'm noticing much of a difference in my redness. While I do enjoy this face wash, I don't think it accomplishes it's task for my skin. I do like the smell (or lack of) & how my skin feels after using it to wash my face... but my redness has not improved.

Does nothing to smooth redness. Watery product means you waste it coming out of the tube. Then you waste it again as it drips down your face. I dont often write reviews, but I feel so ripped off by this product that I want to warn others. A waste of money.
I love this cleanser. It's a perfect match for my skin. I feel like it's never in stock in stores which really breaks my heart. Please don't make this an online exclusive.
I like this cleanser a lot because it doesn't burn or irritate my sensitive skin. I feel that is helping because I also use the Redness Relief cream afterwards in the morning.

avis.titre: omg my skin feels so nice
avis.texte: I purchased this with the glass skin serum so results may differ from others. This was my best investment in a while. My skin actually felt clean and smooth! I had acne and those acne bumps under the skin that are really annoying at times .My skin has improved like CARZY. I had a single cleanser on the cheaper end before this one, but man this has made my skin pain free. Highly reccomend

I love this daily cleanser! My skin gets mildly irritated and has more breakouts in the summer and I've been very happy with how it looks and feels after using this product daily over the past 30 days.

This cleanser washes all my makeup off and washes off the grime of my night in the morning and leaves my face feeling completely clean, but also not stripped of moisture! It's very acne friendly and gentle on your face too so if that's your concern then this is a great water based moisturizer to go for!

I bought this to specifically help with my redness due to rosacea, and my very oily skin. I did not notice a decrease in either of my concerns. I ended up returning it, and I am still on the search for my holy grail. 🙁 This product did not help me, but it may help you. And with Ulta's great return policy it makes the decision to try a new product an easy one.
Fantastic 1st step cleanser - excellent help for my rosacea. Gentle and easy rinsing with no residue feel.

It provided relief to my redness. Gentle enough to use it all over my face and even removes some makeup too. Doesn't really have a smell which is nice. Reduced my breakouts. Definitely recommend! I've used 3 bottles so far.

I have a lot of redness in my cheeks that can flare up easily. I use this cleanser twice a day, in the morning and at night in combination with an oil cleanser. I like this cleanser because it's gentle on my skin and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or irritated afterward.

avis.titre: BEST face wash for sensitive/red prone skin
avis.texte: I've tried so many different face washes targeted towards sensitive skin and every single one has caused an allergic or adverse reaction such as peeling skin or terrible redness and irritation. This is my holy grail, it is so gentle on my skin and isn't drying at all. I've bought several bottles now which I can't say I've done with any other face wash. Another plus is it has a 100% rating on the Yuka app.

I love this cleanser! Makes my face feel so soft and smooth and the redness relief results are amazing! Sooo refreshing and I love the ingredients mention all the algae makes me feel like a sea goddess. Also love because it is a cheaper option than the other cleaners and still a great product!

avis.titre: Not bad but it's a cleans
avis.texte: Not bad but it's a cleanser so it won't do the whole trick of clearing up my redness but it doesn't irritate my skin at all and is a good cleanser

LOVE the redness correcting moisterizer but i have combination skin and sensitive skin. this completely dried out my skin and stripped it of all oils to the point of flaking. i had to give it to a friend ): dissapointed but i will forever be the biggest fan of the moisterizer in this line
I have used this for a month and my skin has gotten inflamed,dry,patchy, raw/sting/itchy painful/stiff feeling,breakouts and purple/red tone on everywhere but my forehead.
Peach and lily are the best products I've ever used! And I've used thousands. From high end expensive to not so expensive. Great ingredients which is what I look for. I'm hooked for life!
I love this product. I've tried other reddness reducing moisturizers, but nothing compares to Peach and Lily's. This moisturizer calms and evens out my skin. Most days it's the only "makeup " I use.

I wish I would have discovered Peach & Lily a long time ago. I have sensitive skin and rosacea and this cleanser, along with the other Redness Relief products, has helped improve the redness on my cheeks so much! I am planning to buy more when I run out!

The first bottle I got was insanely runny, like milk almost, but since I had never used it before, I just rolled with it. The second bottle has a much more normal consistency, like your average opaque skincare cleanser. It does help to control redness without being drying.

I love this cleanser! It feels so nice to wash your face with. I have really sensitive skin and some cleansers are way too harsh and can cause me to break out. This one does not! And even though it is super mild, my skin feels really clean and clear after I use it. It's delightful to use.

For my fellow pcos ladies, this product helps soo much! Limits the acne, skin feels smoothed and refreshed, 8/10 on redusing the redness. This will always be a staple in my beauty routine. Also, to help with the smell change, which happens, shake the bottle before use.

I think it's helped with my redness but I don't think it's doing much else for me as a cleanser. Definitely good for sensitive skin and makes my skin feel clean in general though. Didn't really help with acne, I don't think it's meant for that though so to be expected. Paired with the color correction cream is great!

avis.titre: Good if you don't wear makeup
avis.texte: I dont wear makeup and fjnd this to be good. Not a big difference im seeing in redness. I saw mkre of a difference with peach slices oil free mosturizer (i have combo sensitive skin) but it may have been my other mosturizer causing my face to redden. Anyways, if youre gonna get this, dont expect it to turn over your redness overnight. Also, i didnt get any breakouts from this (usually i get whiteheads on my face when i try new products but i didnt get any from this)

I have oily sensitive skin. I am 47 and this has been an issue my whole life. I struggle with rosacea as well. This cleanser is perfection and makes my skin so healthy and nourished in all the right ways! Did I mention I'm an esthetician. Trust me you need the set.
My face doesn't feel as tight or irritated after cleansing like it normally does. Redness is noticably improved and the texture of my skin feels much better.

Phenomenal cleanser- I have sensitive acne-prone skin, and it cleaned my skin very well without being overly stripping. Skin always felt hydrated and soothed, yet completely free of makeup, sunscreen, and dirt after using it as a second cleanser. Unfortunately, it went bad within 6 months (completely changed texture and smell) despite the PAO symbol noting 12 months- I'm not sure if this is why some reviewers noticed a bad smell. For this reason alone, I'm not sure about repurchasing it.

avis.titre: I Swear By This Cleanser But..
avis.texte: This cleanser keeps my rosacea away and calms my skin. I have super sensitive skin and it is hard to find products that don't irritate it. I would recommend this to anyone dealing with rosacea or facial redness. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because it has a meat smell. Not a super strong one but you'll notice.

It had a really nice texture and no smell, and felt really good to wash but was super drying. After I used it within 30 min my skin felt very tight and even with a super hydrating moisturizer nothing made my skin feel hydrated while using this. It also made my cheeks have a some irritation and break out as well as some of my fine lines become more noticeable.
Definitely helps soothe skin, but I don't notice a huge difference in redness. But my skin is smoother and feels less irritated.

This product has been extremely helpful reducing the redness in my cheeks and forehead. It's a great addition to your face routine—the product has a great consistency and is not harsh on the skin, which is something I've struggled with in the past with other cleansers, especially with my sensitive skin. If you're wondering if you should buy this, do yourself and your skin a favor—do it!
It definitely calms soothe the redness of my cheeks and face. My skin matches the rest of my skin tone.

I absolutely love this. I think this is my favorite face wash I've used in a long time. It really calms my redness down and helps soothe my skin. It isn't drying when you use it and doesn't have a weird smell, which is great!

I use this after applying my primary moisturizer/SPF and it definitely helps dull the redness from dry skin and acne and dark under eyes. I still use concealer to fully even my skin tone, but this is a great option to improve the worst of the color inconsistencies. There is a slight smell but goes away quickly.

avis.titre: Inexpensive gem of a cleanser!! Quality!
avis.texte: Fantastic irritation-free cleanser that really does seem to calm my rosacea prone skin… and so reasonably priced!! Really cleans well, and no scent either!

I will give this product its due. It works guys. It's not stripping, feels good on my skin, etc. I don't know how much it reduces redness though, but it certainly doesn't irritate and I find the products I use after this absorbing better. BUT the smell is something I can't get over. For context, I have an abnormally good sense of smell. It has that weird, almost rancid soap smell that some other fragrance free products have. I'll probably switch to another product once I finish this one because the smell really bothers me. That said, if you don't have a really sensitive sense of smell this product may not bother you, and it works very well at what it's intended to do.
I really like this cleanser. It's soothing and my face doesn't feel stripped after use. This whole redness relief line is great.

I wanted to like this product and thought I had found an alternate product to use for my redness and rosacea, I was wrong. This dried my face out sooo much. And the smell…….the cleanser smelled like puked up milk! But the drying is what turned me off of it. Made my skin flaky and super dry. This produxt is a no-go for me!!

I've been using one of their cleansers for probably close to a year, and wanted to try this out as I have some red on my face. I do have one of the other ointments to counteract the red, but I always forget to use it so I figured the cleanser would be a better option. THIS SMELLS AWFUL if you couldn't tell by my review title. I pretty much put it on my face and took it right off. As I'm writing this review, I noticed my face doesn't feel very good either, its burning a bit and everything else on my face I have been using so it's not working well with the other products. Hopefully I can return it. I don't know if it works with the redness, as it is nighttime.

I really like this moisturizer. I like that it does not dry out my skin but actually provides a little relief from the dryness and is soothing. Not sure about the redness relief aspect but it does make my skin feel nice.
Light cleanser. Leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh. It smells good. My face and cheeks are ready to take on the day.

Before using this cleanser I would use Cetaphil. I realized after washing my face I had A LOT of redness around my cheeks. Now ever since I bought this cleanser its been nothing but work wonders for my redness. Not only that but it's pretty good for sensitive skin. I also would like to point out that smell doesn't even have a smell. I'm not sure why people are saying that the smell is terrible when there's is NO smell?? For any skin products I would avoid anything with a fragrance smell on it.

avis.titre: good cleanser, smell is a NO
avis.texte: it's a good cleanser. I have dry, acne prone skin. I was looking for a morning cleanser to help with redness since I have my prescription one for night. it's a good cleanser and it did help my redness. however, it smells so bad. ik fragrance is usually bad but sometimes it's necessary

avis.titre: its okay but i think it broke me out a little
avis.texte: I been using it for a while and i think it did calm the redness down on my cheeks. bug i think after a while im noticing red bumps. I think its breaking me out a little. Im not sure if i have roseaca but i do have sensitive combination skin. It does feel nice just not for my skin type
This is very light and definitely worth it if you have sensitive skin!

I recramed from writing this but just want to be bonest. Of course saw on tik tok after first use my face burned raw cheeks and forehearx. Ive never expeienced this and i like to try new peofucts often. I even made a second attempt months later again same irritated feeling at least i have vadelije to prevent the drying out and pain. Considering its suppose to be calming please be cautious when using. Im avid dermalogica face wash user only thing that calmed my skin after.

This cleanser would be a fine gentle cleanser if it didnt smell so awful. In an effort not to waste it It took so much will power for me to use as much if this as possible before finally purchasing something else. If you want something that is just as affordable and gentle go with the aveeno oat cleanser, just as gentle and good for redness (honestly better for that) and its actually as unscented as if claims to be !

I was skeptical of this only because I have sensitive skin and a lot of moisturizers including Cetaphil and Cerave irritate my skin. This did not and I was sooooo happy. I'm now going to be a regular customer thanks to the formulation of this line.
Love love love this cleanser! It's not too harsh for my skin and it really does reduce redness. If your skin doesn't react well with other harsher cleansers, try this one!

avis.titre: Love this Brand, hate this product
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this out, especially after loving the blemish busting toner and the acne spot dots. But this smelled AWFUL. absolutely horrible. I had to return it very shortly after trying it. And aside from the smell, the cleanser didn't feel like it was doing much. Didn't leave my face feeling soothed or clean. Really upsetting.

This one is not my favorite. I prefer a foaming cleanser and this is not it. I've not noticed and redness relief but my skin does feel nice after using it. It's not heavy and it rinses away clearly. I'll likely not buy it again but it was worth a try.

Love this stuff! I've using two other popular gentle cleansers but they did not have additional redness relief ingredients. This one is something special — I really can feel that it's calming. Doesnt dry out my mild rosacea, sensitive, normal/dry, acne prone skin. A little goes a long way! You do not need a lot for this cleanser to foam. Will buy again today!
Easily seen results within only a week of use! Less reddened skin as promised!
The cleanser has helped to decrease the redness in my cheeks, and has made my skin feel much smoother.

avis.titre: one of the best cleansers ever!
avis.texte: honestly no one talks about this cleanser but its one of my holy grails! ive lost count of how many times ive bought it but its so good. i have super sensitive and dry skin and i feel like most moisturizing cleansers usually make me break out but this one is so gentle and calming it honestly changed my skin!
Great cleanser. Non irritating for my sensitive skin, and very effective in removing makeup!
The redness in my cheeks has faded. My skin looks cleaner and smoother. Totally recommend

avis.titre: So happy with the instant look
avis.texte: I have been interested in the peach slices brand for a while and I don't regret trying the redness relief line. Bought with the toner and the moisturizer. Using 3x a week and I love that it's instant relief and great cleansing. No complaints on this one from recent redness issues

It works wonderful on my skin type, rosacea causes the skin to be very sensitive but this is a gengle cleanser that leaves my face feeling hydratated and clean! I love it so much! I'm repurchasing the second tube and definitely keeping it on my skincare routing forever :)

I suffer from redness on my cheeks and eyebrow area. This cleanser really addresses my problem. I've used this cleanser for a few weeks and have seen a clear improvement in diminishing redness. I would definitely recommend to add this product to your routine to help prevent redness.

I used this a few times and it has a really funky smell but I couldn't place it. I realized it smells just like I'm washing my face with vomit. It's absolutely horrible and I wanted to love this because it is a nice soothing cleanser. I can't use this without feeling sick to my stomach. I love you peach & lily, but this is not good. :nauseated_face:
This stuff is awesome! I love how it instantly removes the redness from my face, and it feels great!
Haven't noticed a major difference with redness yet, but it smells good, feels good, and doesn't dry out your skin.

This cleanser is nice and light feeling but it does leave my oily skin feeling tight and dry. I use it in combination with the redness relief serum (which is magical) and then follow with a different brand BB cream if I'm going out or the matching moisturizer for bed and it seems to serve me well. I wouldn't recommend as a stand alone cleanser though, there are plenty of better options I think.
I have been using this face wash for a couple months, and I've noticed a huge difference! It has helped calm down the rosacea in my cheeks a lot. It does take a couple days to notice a difference.

I tyically never write reviews but I want to hype this product up! This cleanser never leaves me tight and dry. I almost instantly saw results in the decrease of my redness! super soothing and gentle. as a student esthetician, i highly recommend this product 🖤

I got this on a whim since cleansers that claimed to be gentle only irritated and dried out my skin and OHHH MY GOD. I began using this before I knew the redness on my face was rosacea but by the 3rd day of using this I'd made more progress in soothing the redness than I had in months. My face has calmed down a ton since I've used this and this'll be my go to from now on.

I've always had very pink/red skin, esp since developing hormonal acne, but this cleanser calms it down a lot! It doesn't have a scent, lathers and rinses off easily, and I haven't noticed any new breakouts from it.
this makes my skin and face feel so smooth. The consistency at that. It's really calming.
Love this gentle cleanser for the morning when I don't have to remove makeup or sunscreen. This is exactly what I was looking for.

avis.titre: No other cleanser has done this
avis.texte: Wow!! I never write reviews on here but I just had to for this product! If you have rosacea give this a try! I have redness all over my face that no cleanser has ever helped. The first time I used this cleanser I saw instant results. My redness disappeared almost completely! On top of that if did not dry out or tighten my skin!! My husband and I were amazed! He said he wasn't used to seeing me without the redness and it was weird 😂 As long as this product is around I'll never stop buying it!!!

avis.titre: Definitely a go to cleanser for me.
avis.texte: Soothing and gentle. Milky and moisturizing. Please never discontinue this line/product. Product rinses off clean which is important for me since i struggle with rosacea. The longer it takes to rinse a product off effects how red/irritated my skin is later.
This face wash is so great! I absolutely love it combined with the moisturizer.

I was nervous having used the Peach & Lilly face wash first but this is actually really nice and soothing as advertised. My skin is less red and irritated, and the texture is much more even. I'm unsure of how it is doing for my acne issues but it tends to be stubborn and I will take any improvement over none lol. The glass skin collection cleanser leaves my skin a touch softer but if you want something that is more budget friendly that remains effective this is worth a try!
In just a couple days, the rosacea was reduced on my cheeks and nose! Can't wait to try their other products!
foams up nicely, is free of all the bad stuff. one thing to note is that it has a slightly weird smell almost like a barbecue and if you have super dry skin maybe skip on this!

I was a little skeptical that this would work. I have had rosacea all my life and nothing ever reduced the redness nor made my skin feel good. I've been using this for a week and I'm finally noticing some reduction in the redness! I can't believe it! It's really gentle and doesn't burn my face! My cheeks don't look as red anymore.

avis.titre: Makes me glow to the high heavens
avis.texte: This cleanser is kinda insane in the way it makes me glow. It literally leaves me with perfect rosy cheeks. I have fairly normal skin that gets the occasional breakout when it's that time of the month, and usually behaves, but this really adds some extra oomph. I use this in conjunction with BR P50 and the Peach Slices snail mucin and my skin is so good. Highly recommend!
